name: RideJaunm Prompt Tree
description: Dependency-ordered prompt system for executing and extending the RideJaunm design programme. Nodes inherit locked constraints from their parents and emit machine-readable handoffs to their children.

project.name: RideJaunm
project.domain: Motorcycle riding companion app for Nepal

execution_modes.GENERATE: Greenfield. Full output from scratch. Use only for new feature areas with no existing spec.
execution_modes.EXTEND: DEFAULT. Spec exists; produce only the delta. Cite what already covers the rest.
execution_modes.AUDIT: No new design. Return a findings table with severity and file:section references.

requirement_tags.NEW: Genuinely missing from docs/. This is where the value is.
requirement_tags.EXTEND: Partially covered; needs depth, a variant, or a missing case.
requirement_tags.VALIDATE: Already specified. Verify against docs/, do not regenerate.

questions.question: Environmental context: handlebar-mounted in Himalayan sun, or tank bag?
questions.answer: Handlebar-mounted, direct sun, gloved. Primary and non-negotiable. Tank bag is a subset.
questions.blast_radius_if_changed: CATASTROPHIC — full re-spec of sizing, type, contrast, modes, testing

questions.question: Visual vibe: rugged tactical or cyber-tech neon?
questions.answer: Hybrid — Himalayan-Tactical Tech. Tactical base + exactly one neon accent, allocated by surface class.
questions.blast_radius_if_changed: HIGH — docs/01, 03, 07 and all hi-fi; structure survives

questions.question: Map engine: vector or satellite-terrain?
questions.answer: Both, switchable. Satellite-3D while riding; vector while planning; vector offline; vector in day-glare.
questions.blast_radius_if_changed: MEDIUM — map style, tile budget, Branch 3 layouts

questions.question: SOS mesh UI: technical signal data or consumer-friendly?
questions.answer: Progressive disclosure. Plain language default (state + magnitude + age); technical diagnostics one tap away, never buried.
questions.blast_radius_if_changed: LOW-MEDIUM — contained to the SOS subsystem

requirements.why_hard: Prithvi Highway is the STRAIGHT corridor. Supercurvy must divert via Nuwakot/Bandipur, costing ~+90km and ~+2.5h. Core UX problem: sell that as a reward, not an error.

amendment_policy.trigger: Any change to a root-node answer or a LOCKED_CONSTRAINT
steps: State the blast radius (nodes + docs invalidated)
Bump tree version — root changes are always MAJOR
Re-run affected nodes in AUDIT mode before EXTEND
Update 00-root-node.md with answer, date and reason
